Exam Date & Time: 10-Dec-2022 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING)  
  EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2022  
  SUBJECT : ECE 2153 - DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE 2153]  
Marks: 50                                                                          Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Implement 1:16 demultiplexer using only 1:4 demultiplexer with functional table.  
  (4)  
  
1B)          Perform 3-bit subtraction operation of 101-011 using 3-bit parallel binary  
  adder/subtractor circuit.                                                                (3)  
  
$$1C)          Reduce the function F(A,B,C) = Π M (0,1,2,3,4,7) using K-Map and Implement the$$  
  same using only NOR gates.                                                               (3)  
  
2A)          What are the universal gates? Simplify the following Boolean expression using  
  Karnaugh map and draw the logic circuit using only NAND gates                            (4)  
  $$F(A,B,C,D)=\sum m(6,7,8,9,10,12)+d(2,5,13)$$  
  
2B)          Derive the characteristic equation of P-Q flipflop. The characteristics table of P-Q  
  flipflop is as follows. Convert P-Q flipflop to D flipflop  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
2C)          Design a Mealy overlapping sequence detector that detects sequence 101 using D  
  flipflop and necessary gate.                                                             (3)  
  
3A)          Implement 1111 overlapping sequence detector using Mealy model and draw the circuit  
  diagram using D- flip flop and necessary logic gates.                               (4)  
  
3B)          Construct a 2-bit synchronous up counter using T-flip flop.  
  (3)  
  
3C)          Write a dataflow Verilog code for 2-to-4 decoder with active low enable input and active  
  low outputs.                                                                             (3)  
  
4A)          Write the structural Verilog code for 8:1 multiplexer using 2:1 multiplexer.  
  (4)  
  
4B)          Write the Verilog code for 3 input NAND gate using User defined primitive.  
  (3)  
  
4C)          Write the sequential Verilog code for positive edge triggered J-K Flipflop.  
  (3)  
  
5A)          Implement a 4-bit SISO register using Xilinx CLB.  
  (4)

$$5B)             Implement F = \sum  m (1,3,5,6) using ACT-1 module.$$  
  (3)  
  
5C)             Implement a BCD to XS-3 code conversion circuit using PROM.
